req.title: PUT rejects payload ID mismatch
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 400 when the playerId in the path does not match the id in the PUT body.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that PUT /players/squadnumber/{squad_number} must return HTTP 400 when the squad_number in the path does not match the squad_number in the request body. The route handler checks `if player_model.squad_number != squad_number` and raises HTTPException(400). Tests must cover: (1) positive — matching IDs yield non-400 response; (2) negative — mismatched IDs yield exactly 400; (3) boundary — squad_number differing by exactly ±1 from path value triggers 400. Additional tests cover the exact constant (400), both sides of the equality operator, and the decision table for match vs mismatch to maximise mutation kill rate.

tests.name: test_put_matching_squad_number_not_rejected
preconditions: Player with squadNumber=10 exists in the database (pre-loaded fixture)
Request body squad_number matches path parameter
actions: Send PUT /players/squadnumber/10 with body containing squadNumber=10
expected: HTTP response status code is NOT 400
Response status code is 204 (no content) or 500 (db bug in source), but never 400
trace: R-PLAYER-011: matching IDs must not trigger the 400 guard
Catches comparison-mutation: != flipped to == would reject matching payloads
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=False)
payload = {
    "firstName": "Kabir",
    "middleName": "Mary",
    "lastName": "Reddy",
    "dateOfBirth": "1910-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
    "squadNumber": 10,
    "position": "Right Winger",
    "abbrPosition": "DM",
    "team": "River Plate",
    "league": "Ligue 1",
    "starting11": False
}
response = client.put("/players/squadnumber/10", json=payload)
assert response.status_code != 400, f"Expected non-400 for matching IDs, got {response.status_code}"
assert response.status_code in (204, 500), f"Unexpected status {response.status_code}"

def test_put_matching_squad_number_not_rejected():
    response = client.put("/players/squadnumber/10", json=payload)
    assert response.status_code != 400
    assert response.status_code in (204, 500)

tests.name: test_put_mismatch_check_precedes_404_lookup

Request body squad_number=888 does not match path=999

expected: HTTP response status code is exactly 400 (mismatch guard fires before 404 lookup)
trace: R-PLAYER-011: 400 must be returned even when the resource does not exist
DT: decision table row — mismatch=true, exists=false → 400 not 404
Catches mutation that reorders the mismatch check after the DB lookup
